title: finance-legal personal todo - invoices & contract redlines
content:
Personal scratchpad - finance/legal tasks (running list)

Last updated: 2026-03-02
Owner: Samir Patel
Context: quick daily notes to track invoice checks, contract redlines, renewal reminders, and small follow-ups. Not formal, may include shorthand and links to tickets.

TODAY
- [ ] Run invoice QC for Feb payouts (priority)
    - Check for duplicate INV IDs (sample: INV-2026-02-11)
    - Confirm tax withholding flags for international vendors (Vendor: ClearPort)
    - Match amounts to PO where available (see PO-7782)
- [ ] Finish redline for Acme Data Services SOW v3
    - Pending: final liability clause language from legal (Maya to review)
    - Add 30-day termination clause as discussed 2026-02-28 meeting
    - Action: send updated draft to Jordan and request CMS track changes
- [ ] Renewal reminders
    - Zendesk subscription auto-renew 2026-04-15 -> start renewal checklist by 2026-03-15
    - Cloud infra support (AcmeCloud) renewal: confirm seat count (current: 12) and escalate price increase >10%
- [ ] Expense reimbursements backlog (personal/ops cards)
    - Attach receipts for Mar travel (SFO) to EXP-2026-03 (deadline 2026-03-10)

FOLLOW-UPS / NOTES
- Vendor: DataSentrix invoice INV-2026-01-45 flagged (missing backup) -> reached out 2026-02-26, follow up if no response by 2026-03-04
- Contract: Marketplace reseller agreement (MR-2025-07) needs indemnity clause alignment w/ platform standard - hold before signature; possible ask: add Redwood standard sec 9.2
- Payment runs: weekly on Fridays; confirm treasury block for 2026-03-05 due to holiday

MEETING/THREAD TODOs
- Legal sync 2026-03-03: bring SOW v3 redline, highlight proposed 30-day termination and data handling updates
- Finance ops retro: present invoice error rates (Q4 -> Q1) and propose small automation rule to reject missing tax IDs

QUICK LINKS / TICKETS (for copy/paste)
- FIN ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-324 (invoice QC rule)
- Legal PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/legal/pull/112 (SOW v3 redline)
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/9876543/Invoice+process

IDEAS / BRAIN DUMP
- Could we add an auto-check for vendor bank details change that triggers kyc verification? low-effort rule in vendor portal to lock payments until cleared.
- Small UX improvement request for vendor invoice upload: require PO number field to be selected from active POs (reduces matching errors)

HOUSEKEEPING (personal)
- Remind myself to submit last month card reconciliations before 2026-03-10
- Update shared checklist for month-end close (shared_drives/finance/month-end-checklist)

END OF NOTES
(Will prune and create formal tickets for anything that needs tracking)
